body:
P2-25 DESIGN, part 2: the fold table and the places that use it (docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md, parts 2 to 6; every number below was RUN on main 64f3067 with Python 3.13.14, Unicode 15.1.0, or on a throwaway prototype in the scratch folder, not committed).

ONE FOLD, TWO STAGES, in textnorm.py. fold(text) = the character stage and KEEPS punctuation (the typo rule of N-23b needs the symbols $ @ !); words(folded) splits on everything that is not a letter, a digit or a kept mark; key_text = the words joined, with a fallback so no key part is ever empty (cleaned title, else folded text, else the case-folded original: "???" and "!!!" stay two songs). The five old functions keep their names and word rules (noise words, brackets, feat, version words) and are rebuilt on it.

THE SIX STEPS. 1 NFKC (not NFKD: it splits Hangul and Japanese voiced kana). 2 case-fold. 3 remove DECORATING marks by an ALLOW-LIST (U+0300-036F and the other combining blocks; Arabic harakat U+064B-065F, U+0670 and the Quranic marks; Hebrew points), NFD then NFC; any mark not listed is KEPT (Devanagari signs, Thai tone marks, Japanese voiced marks, Hangul pieces). "Strip every mark" and the plain [^\w]+ both split words (run: the Hindi "tum ho" becomes three letters, the Thai greeting two pieces, Arabic with harakat four letters). 4 letters with no decomposition: o-slash, l-stroke, d-stroke, eth, thorn (th), ae, oe, dotless i, h-stroke, t-stroke; Arabic alef forms to alef, alef maksura and the Persian and Urdu yeh to yeh, keheh to kaf, teh marbuta to heh, tatweel removed; KEPT APART on purpose: the Cyrillic short i, yo, yi, short u (two Russian words differ by one: moy and moi) and the hamza seats. 5 every Nd digit to ASCII (670 outside ASCII). 6 format characters (bidi marks, joiners, soft hyphen, BOM) removed with no gap.
ARTIST_SPLIT gains the Arabic comma and semicolon and the ideographic comma; _BRACKETS gains the Japanese and Chinese brackets (the title with a MV tag in black lenticular brackets has a bracket to remove).
PROPERTIES RUN on the prototype: 20,000 seeded ASCII strings give exactly the old word list (so a key made of ASCII does not change); fold is idempotent over EVERY code point; no letter or digit gives an empty key; 26 native-script rows as expected (the one difference was my wrong expectation: NFKC gives katakana, not hiragana).

PLACES THAT FOLD (read): textnorm.py five functions; refs.norm_key, find, resolve and facts_to_fill (empty equals empty for any two non-Latin artists); navidrome.pick_song; keeper/placement _folder_key (a third [^a-z0-9] the 6 Nov list missed) and find_existing (returns None for every Arabic title, so a re-keep writes Title (2).opus); cover_finder deezer_lookup and the by_album key; artist_finder; sources/youtube lean and scoring; imports/uploads _name_key and _words (N-26 own folds, their comment promises replacement in the same change); catalogue._FOLD (a copy of the phone table); on the phone text_match.dart:95 and CoverFallbacks.key (a stored cache key: one re-lookup). readers.py has no fold of its own any more.

THE MATCHER AFTER THE FIX: thresholds were calibrated on Latin characters. RUN: Hangul "sarang-hae" against "sarang-i" is 0.667 (the 0.6 title bar passes), Russian moy against moi 0.667, Korean bom-nal against bom-bam 0.5. Default rule: a title or artist of at most four Han, Kana or Hangul characters is compared for EQUALITY; N-16 measures the rest. MATCHER_REVISION goes up by one (voids the 7-day not_found every Arabic song earned; the janitor then sees those verdicts as not live). Version and noise words stay English: per-language lists are DATA, read by a native speaker, added on the evidence of N-16.
